locator: Geology of Korea (1993), ch. 2 §6 p. 233 (PDF p. 236) for the 7 m locality thickness, ch. 3 §7 pp. 342–343 for clast sizes and topographic context. Liu et al. project 95-11 pp. 17–18 and Liu et al. (1998) pp. 14, 18 and 26. Hoang (1987) p. 29 for the 160 cm alternative.

samjiyon_scalar.definition: Attribute the entire reported 7 m Samjiyon pumice deposit to combined primary Millennium fallout at the alternate workbook coordinate.

samjiyon_component.definition: Assume all 7 m at Samjiyon is a primary Millennium fall component at the alternate workbook coordinate. Allow additional unmeasured fallout from the eruption.

samjiyon_complete_stack.definition: Assume the 7 m stack contains all Millennium airfall preserved at the workbook position, together with an unknown contribution from other deposits. Assume preservation represents primary fall. Use 700 cm as an upper limit only under these assumptions.

samjiyon_160.definition: Assign the 1.6 m of pumice substrate reported around Samjiyon by Hoang (1987) to both-phase primary Millennium fall at the alternate workbook position. This deliberately conditional locality transfer tests an alternative to the 7 m account.
